title: 2022 Topps Series 1 Future Stars #248 Alek Manoah Toronto Blue Jays
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2022 Topps Series 1 Future Stars #248 Alek Manoah Toronto Blue Jays trading card is a must-have for any baseball fan. The card features a stunning design and showcases Manoah's impressive skills on the mound. It is an original, limited edition card that is part of the Base Set and includes a Short Print, Stamped, Parallel/Variety, Rookie, Insert, and Chase feature. 

The card is authenticated by Topps and comes from the Major League (MLB) franchise. It is a Sports Trading Card that measures 3½" x 2½" and is perfect for collectors or fans of the Toronto Blue Jays and Blue Jays. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this highly sought-after card to your collection.
